title: Remove support from libnl versions 1 and 2
description:
Libnl3 (libnl >= 3.2, due to when the SONAME bump happened) was released
in 2014. Version 2 was short-lived, and version 1 has API and ABI
incompatibilities. Every Linux distribution that supports our other
minimum requirements has libnl3, and almost all have dropped libnl1.
libpcap dropped support for libnl versions 1 or 2 in 1.10.0
(released December 2020).

This will enable simplifying the API calls, and avoid mixing errnos
with nl error numbers.

+# and version 1 has API and ABI incompatibilities.

-  if(NOT NL3_FOUND)
-    pkg_search_module(NL2 libnl-2.0)
-  endif()
 
-  # Try to find NL 2.0, 3.0 or 3.1 (/usr/include/netlink/version.h) or
-  # NL >= 3.2 (/usr/include/libnl3/netlink/version.h)
+  # Try to find NL >= 3.2 (/usr/include/libnl3/netlink/version.h)
   find_path(NL3_INCLUDE_DIR
     PATH_SUFFIXES
       include/libnl3

+        nl-3

         $(SEARCHPATHS)
     )
     find_library(NLGENL_LIBRARY
       NAMES

+        nl-genl-3
       PATH_SUFFIXES
         lib64 lib
       HINTS
         "${NL3_libnl-genl-3.0_LIBDIR}"
-        "${NL2_LIBDIR}"
       PATHS
         $(SEARCHPATHS)
     )
     find_library(NLROUTE_LIBRARY
       NAMES
-        nl-route-3 nl-route
+        nl-route-3
       PATH_SUFFIXES
         lib64 lib
       HINTS
         "${NL3_libnl-route-3.0_LIBDIR}"
-        "${NL2_LIBDIR}"
       PATHS
         $(SEARCHPATHS)
     )
@@ -83,48 +72,13 @@ else()
     if(NL3_LIBRARY AND NLGENL_LIBRARY AND NLROUTE_LIBRARY)
       set(NL_LIBRARY ${NL3_LIBRARY})
       if(NL3_INCLUDE_DIR)
-        # NL2 and NL3 are similar and just affect how the version is reported in
-        # the --version output. In cast of doubt, assume NL3 since a library
-        # without version number could be any of 2.0, 3.0 or 3.1.
-        if(NOT NL3_FOUND AND NL2_FOUND)

-        else()
-          set(HAVE_LIBNL3 1)
-        endif()
+        set(HAVE_LIBNL3 1)
       endif()
     endif()
     set(NL_INCLUDE_DIR ${NL3_INCLUDE_DIR})
   endif()

 endif()
